What does “dream of” mean here?

translation.stem: 我梦想拥有一栋海边小屋，让家人可以住在那里。 这里“dream of”是什么意思？

questions.explanation: Here, “dream of” means “to wish strongly for something you would like in the future”.
questions.parentExplanation: 本题考查“dream of”在本句中的用法；正确英文解释为“to wish strongly for something you would like in the future”。对应源表释义为“梦想”。

questions.stem:
For the class play, the children dress up as forest animals.
What does “dress up” mean here?

translation.stem: 为了演班级剧，孩子们装扮成森林动物。 这里“dress up”是什么意思？

questions.explanation: Here, “dress up” means “to wear clothes that make you look like a character”.
questions.parentExplanation: 本题考查“dress up”在本句中的用法；正确英文解释为“to wear clothes that make you look like a character”。对应源表释义为“①装扮 ②穿得正式；装扮；打扮”。

questions.stem:
The teacher needs the form now. Please bring it to her at once.
What does “at once” mean here?

translation.stem: 老师现在就需要表格。请马上把它带给她。 这里“at once”是什么意思？

questions.explanation: Here, “at once” means “immediately, without delay”.
questions.parentExplanation: 本题考查“at once”在本句中的用法；正确英文解释为“immediately, without delay”。对应源表释义为“立刻，马上”。

questions.stem:
After many tries, I can at last ride the bicycle without help.
What does “at last” mean here?

translation.stem: 经过多次尝试，我终于能独立骑自行车了。 这里“at last”是什么意思？

questions.explanation: Here, “at last” means “finally, after waiting or difficulty”.
questions.parentExplanation: 本题考查“at last”在本句中的用法；正确英文解释为“finally, after waiting or difficulty”。对应源表释义为“最后，终于”。

questions.stem: The cat c________ the box and stands on the floor.
questions.hint: Use the phrase meaning moves from inside to outside; agree with the cat.
questions.grammar: 第三人称单数comes out of
questions.explanation: The cat leaves the inside of the box; a singular subject takes comes.
questions.parentExplanation: 猫从箱内到箱外，填comes out of；主语单数。

translation.stem: 猫从箱子里出来，站在地板上。

questions.stem: This sentence is not needed. Please c________ neatly with one line.
questions.hint: Use it for this sentence; put the pronoun between the verb and the particle.
questions.explanation: The pronoun it must go between cross and out.
questions.parentExplanation: it指this sentence；代词宾语必须放cross与out之间。

translation.stem: 这个句子不需要。请用一条线整齐地把它划掉。

questions.stem: Please c________ the carrots into small pieces for the soup.
questions.hint: Use the two-word cutting phrase whose main verb has the same form in the past.
questions.explanation: The carrots need to be made into small pieces, so cut up fits.
questions.parentExplanation: 切成小块用cut up；cut的过去式也为cut。

translation.stem: 请把胡萝卜切成小块，放进汤里。

questions.stem: For the team game, we d________ four groups of six students.
questions.hint: Use the phrase meaning split the class into groups; put the class between the verb and into.
questions.grammar: divide + 对象 + into + 部分
questions.explanation: The class is the object being separated, so use divide the class into.
questions.parentExplanation: divide与into之间放被分对象the class；组数在into后。

translation.stem: 为参加团队游戏，我们把全班分成四组，每组六人。

questions.stem: Mia d________ becoming a doctor so that she can help sick children.
questions.hint: Use the two-word phrase with of meaning wish strongly for a future possibility; agree the verb with the subject.
questions.explanation: The future hope is becoming a doctor; Mia takes dreams of.
questions.parentExplanation: Mia单数用dreams；of是介词，后接becoming。

translation.stem: 米娅梦想成为医生，以帮助生病的孩子。

questions.stem: We d________ in our best suits and dresses for the formal dinner.
questions.hint: Use the phrase meaning wear smart, formal clothes for an occasion.
questions.explanation: Putting on formal clothes for the dinner is dressing up.
questions.parentExplanation: 为正式场合盛装打扮，用dress up；本题不是装扮角色。

translation.stem: 我们穿上最好的西装和礼服，正式着装参加晚宴。

questions.stem: Our online class has students from a________, from many different countries.
questions.hint: in every part of the world
questions.explanation: All over the world means in every part of the world.
questions.parentExplanation: from后接all over the world，表示来自世界各地。

translation.stem: 我们的在线课堂有来自世界各地的学生，他们来自许多不同国家。

questions.stem: My parents give me a little p________ each week for small things I want to buy.
questions.hint: money parents give a child for small personal needs
questions.explanation: Pocket money is money a child gets for small personal needs.
questions.parentExplanation: pocket money表示父母给孩子的零花钱，money不加复数词尾。

translation.stem: 父母每周给我一点零花钱，买我想要的小东西。

questions.stem: Why does the class leave out a dance?
questions.explanation: The answer is “The song and story take nearly all the available time.”. Evidence: We add up the minutes for each part before choosing another activity. The song and story already take nearly all our time. Instead of adding a dance, we leave a few minutes for questions.
questions.parentExplanation: 正确项为“The song and story take nearly all the available time.”。原文依据：我们合计各部分所需的分钟数，再选其他活动。歌曲和故事已经占了我们几乎全部时间。我们没有再加舞蹈，而是留几分钟回答问题。

questions.stem: What is the main idea?
questions.explanation: The answer is “A class plans a show to fit the time available.”. Evidence: Our class plans a short show for parents on Friday afternoon. We decide to begin with a simple song that everyone knows. We add up the minutes for each part before choosing another activity. The song and story already take nearly all our time. Instead of adding a dance, we leave a few minutes for questions. The plan helps us know what to practise and when to finish.
questions.parentExplanation: 正确项为“A class plans a show to fit the time available.”。原文依据：我们班计划在周五下午给家长表演一个短节目。我们决定以一首大家都熟悉的简单歌曲开始。我们合计各部分所需的分钟数，再选其他活动。歌曲和故事已经占了我们几乎全部时间。我们没有再加舞蹈，而是留几分钟回答问题。这个计划帮助我们明确练什么、何时结束。

questions.stem: Which title fits the passage best?
questions.explanation: The answer is “Reading Day Finds a Dry New Home”. Evidence: A heavy rainstorm changes the plan for our school reading day. Because of the wet playground, we move the activity into the library. The younger children still need their picture books from another room. Our teacher asks us to bring the books to them before lunch. We carry small piles carefully and keep the covers dry. Soon every child can choose a story and sit beside a friend. The rain continues outside, but the library is full of happy reading voices.
questions.parentExplanation: 正确项为“Reading Day Finds a Dry New Home”。原文依据：一场大暴雨改变了学校阅读日的计划。因为操场湿了，我们把活动搬到图书馆。年纪小些的孩子仍需要放在另一间屋里的图画书。老师请我们在午饭前把书带给他们。我们小心地搬着一小摞一小摞书，让封面保持干燥。很快，每个孩子都能选一个故事，坐到朋友身旁。外面仍在下雨，图书馆里却满是愉快的读书声。

translation.stem: 哪个标题最适合短文？

options.label: C

passages.text: Our class plans a short show for parents on Friday afternoon. We decide to begin with a simple song that everyone knows. After that, two students will read a funny story together. We add up the minutes for each part before choosing another activity. The song and story already take nearly all our time. Instead of adding a dance, we leave a few minutes for questions. The plan helps us know what to practise and when to finish.

parallelText.en: The song and story already take nearly all our time.
parallelText.zh: 歌曲和故事已经占了我们几乎全部时间。

parallelText.en: Instead of adding a dance, we leave a few minutes for questions.

parallelText.en: The plan helps us know what to practise and when to finish.
parallelText.zh: 这个计划帮助我们明确练什么、何时结束。
